text.content:
A Hollow room whose original purpose has been overtaken by something considerably less safe to stand near.

GM Notes

Encounter: Roll a random encounter check when the party lingers here more than a few minutes - something has noticed them.

Encounter: This room refills with a new threat if left and returned to later, on the same table used for the floor's other random encounters.
